intent.objective: Perform an independent G0 architecture audit of the repaired CashBooks control plane and return one identity-bound architecture-audit artifact.
intent.rationale: The prior audit could not establish sufficient coverage and exposed a self-declared independence path; this fresh bounded audit evaluates the repaired head.
non_goals: Changing source, policy, schemas, ADRs, scope, or phase criteria
Starting Swift development or evaluating product UI work
Issuing or accepting any human approval
acceptance_behavior: The returned artifact is an architecture-audit for G0 with a fresh eligible architectural-authority identity.
The artifact binds audited_commit exactly to the frozen dispatch head and its Git tree.
The audit covers the repaired ingestion binding, P0 control plane, governance evidence, ADR-0005 acceptance, G0 criteria, and deferred-scope boundaries.
The artifact reports no_blocking_findings only when its findings contain no blocking item.

invalidation_triggers: any non-evidence file changes before ingestion

behavioral_requirements: Audit is independent of all sessions recorded in agent-system/work/P0/CONSTRUCTION-LOG.md.
Audit is bound to the exact frozen commit and tree supplied in the context pack.
Returned artifact validates against architecture-audit.schema.json and contains decision coverage plus findings.
definition_of_done: A fresh eligible architectural-authority session returns the typed audit artifact.
The result is independently ingested against the trusted dispatch binding.

architecture_escalation_conditions: architecture, privacy, financial, or cross-work-package conflict
human_approval_conditions: phase closure, scope change, schema or invariant change
